name: automation_create_workitem

description.what: Submits one run of a named Activity alias, and returns a task handle.
description.when: Use to execute a prepared automation against a resolved model.
description.whenNot: Never to compose a job body, choose an engine or pass a command line. Only a declared Activity alias is accepted.
requires: An Activity alias from the activities config

blastRadius: Starts a billable Design Automation work item. CREATE is in the name because the call is not safely repeatable.
